name: Exp_ColorJFatl_Digit_Tm
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator signals across multiple timeframes. The '_Tm' suffix suggests it incorporates time-based filtering or multi-timeframe confirmation for trade entries and exits. It systematically opens positions when the colored JFATL digital indicator aligns across configured time windows.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJFatl_Digit指标信号在多个时间周期上进行交易。'_Tm'后缀表明它结合了基于时间的过滤或多周期确认来决定入场和出场。当彩色JFATL数字指标在配置的时间窗口内对齐时，系统性地开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于JFATL（Juriy Fast Adaptive Trend Line）数字指标的颜色变化信号进行交易决策。ColorJFatl_Digit指标通过颜色变化表示趋势方向的转变，当指标从一种颜色切换到另一种颜色时产生交易信号。'_Tm'后缀暗示EA加入了时间管理模块，可能限制交易时段或使用多时间周期确认来过滤假信号。入场条件通常是等待JFATL指标颜色变化并得到更高时间周期趋势方向的确认。出场条件可能包括反向颜色信号、固定止损止盈或时间到期强制平仓。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于ATR的动态手数分配。资金管理方面，由于文件为二进制无法读取，无法确认是否包含马丁格尔或网格成分，但从命名推测应为固定比例的系统性交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the color change signals of the JFATL (Juriy Fast Adaptive Trend Line) digital indicator for trade decisions. The ColorJFatl_Digit indicator represents trend direction changes through color transitions, generating trade signals when the indicator switches from one color to another. The '_Tm' suffix suggests the EA incorporates a time management module, potentially restricting trading sessions or using multi-timeframe confirmation to filter out false signals. Entry conditions typically wait for the JFATL indicator color change confirmed by a higher timeframe trend direction alignment. Exit conditions may include reverse color signals, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, or forced closing at time expiration. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or ATR-based dynamic lot allocation. Money management aspects cannot be fully confirmed since the file is binary and unreadable, but based on naming conventions it likely employs fixed-ratio systematic trading without martingale or grid components.

时间管理模块避免在低流动性时段交易
